name: 相关性热力图
description: 从数值字段计算 Pearson、Spearman 或 Kendall 相关系数，输出 300 DPI 热力图、高相关变量对报告并原样传递数据。
masterEvidence: 支持三种相关系数和字段选择
输出 300 DPI 热力图与高相关变量对

params.label: 数值字段
params.hint: 留空时分析全部数值字段；最多 20 个

code:
# E2 相关性热力图：Pearson/Spearman/Kendall + 高相关变量报告
import io
import base64
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'sans-serif',
    'font.sans-serif': ['Microsoft YaHei', 'SimHei', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'],
    'axes.unicode_minus': False,
    'font.size': 10,
    'axes.titlesize': 15,
    'xtick.labelsize': 9,
    'ytick.labelsize': 9,
    'figure.facecolor': 'white',
    'axes.facecolor': 'white',
    'savefig.facecolor': 'white',
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
})

method_label = {{method}}
annotate = bool({{annotate}})
upper_triangle = bool({{upper_triangle}})
selected_columns = {{columns}}
high_threshold = float({{high_correlation_threshold}})


def _to_frame(value):
    if isinstance(value, pd.DataFrame):
        return value.copy()
    if isinstance(value, bytes):
        for encoding in ('utf-8-sig', 'utf-8', 'gbk', 'gb18030'):
            try:
                return pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(value.decode(encoding)))
            except UnicodeDecodeError:
                continue
        raise RuntimeError('CSV 编码无法识别')
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(value.lstrip('\ufeff')))
    raise RuntimeError('输入 data 必须是 CSV 文本或 DataFrame')


if data is None:
    raise RuntimeError('请先连接并运行上游的数据导入插件')
method_map = {'pearson': 'pearson', 'spearman': 'spearman', 'kendall': 'kendall'}
method = method_map.get(str(method_label).strip().lower())
if method is None:
    raise RuntimeError('相关系数方法必须是 Pearson、Spearman 或 Kendall')
if not 0 <= high_threshold <= 1:
    raise RuntimeError('高相关阈值必须在 0 到 1 之间')

df = _to_frame(data)
numeric = df.select_dtypes(include=np.number)
if selected_columns:
    missing = [str(c) for c in selected_columns if str(c) not in df.columns]
    if missing:
        raise RuntimeError('找不到字段：' + '、'.join(missing))
    non_numeric = [str(c) for c in selected_columns if str(c) not in numeric.columns]
    if non_numeric:
        raise RuntimeError('相关性分析只能选择数值字段：' + '、'.join(non_numeric))
    numeric = numeric[[str(c) for c in selected_columns]]
if numeric.shape[1] < 2:
    raise RuntimeError('相关性热力图至少需要 2 个数值字段')
if numeric.shape[1] > 20:
    raise RuntimeError('为保证图表可读性，一次最多选择 20 个数值字段')

corr = numeric.corr(method=method)
high_pairs = []
for i in range(len(corr.columns)):
    for j in range(i + 1, len(corr.columns)):
        value = corr.iloc[i, j]
        if pd.notna(value) and abs(float(value)) >= high_threshold:
            high_pairs.append({
                'column_1': str(corr.columns[i]),
                'column_2': str(corr.columns[j]),
                'correlation': float(value),
            })
high_pairs.sort(key=lambda item: abs(item['correlation']), reverse=True)

count = len(corr.columns)
size = max(6.4, min(12.0, 1.0 + count * 0.62))
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(size, size * 0.82), facecolor='white')
mask = np.triu(np.ones_like(corr, dtype=bool), k=1) if upper_triangle else None
sns.heatmap(
    corr,
    mask=mask,
    cmap=sns.diverging_palette(240, 12, s=85, l=42, as_cmap=True),
    vmin=-1,
    vmax=1,
    center=0,
    annot=annotate,
    fmt='.2f',
    annot_kws={'size': 8.5},
    square=True,
    linewidths=0.7,
    linecolor='white',
    cbar_kws={'label': '相关系数', 'shrink': 0.82},
    ax=ax,
)
ax.set_title(f'{method_label} 相关性热力图', loc='left', fontweight='bold', pad=16)
ax.set_xlabel('')
ax.set_ylabel('')
ax.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=38)
ax.tick_params(axis='y', rotation=0)
fig.text(0.08, 0.025, f'注：共 {count} 个数值字段；|r| ≥ {high_threshold:.2f} 的变量对共 {len(high_pairs)} 组。', fontsize=8.5, color='#666666')
fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.16, right=0.92, top=0.91, bottom=0.17)
_buffer = io.BytesIO()
fig.savefig(_buffer, format='png', dpi=300, facecolor='white', bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close(fig)
image = 'data:image/png;base64,' + base64.b64encode(_buffer.getvalue()).decode('ascii')
report = {
    'method': method,
    'columns': [str(c) for c in corr.columns],
    'matrix': {str(row): {str(col): (None if pd.isna(corr.loc[row, col]) else float(corr.loc[row, col])) for col in corr.columns} for row in corr.index},
    'high_correlation_threshold': high_threshold,
    'high_correlation_pairs': high_pairs,
}
return {'image': image, 'report': report, 'data': data}
